ambiguity.issue: These phrases permit two materially different acceptance semantics unless explicitly bound: exact finite-portfolio comparison, or inference about an underlying task population represented by the portfolio.

premises: THE ACCEPTANCE OBJECT IS EXACTLY THE FROZEN CONTENT_ADDRESSED FINITE CASE MANIFEST
THE MANIFEST IS COMPLETE RELATIVE TO THE DECLARED MATCHED ACCEPTANCE SCOPE
BRAIN AND OPUS SHARE THE SAME CASE UNIVERSE AND BINARY SUCCESS CRITERION
consequence: THE EXACT FINITE SUCCESS REDUCER R=K/N IS THE ACCEPTANCE REDUCER
IF BRAIN PROVES SUCCESS ON EVERY CASE THEN R_BRAIN=1
BECAUSE TARGET SUCCESS FRACTION CANNOT EXCEED 1, BRAIN IS NONINFERIOR WITHOUT ANY OPUS CASE EXECUTION

premises: THE PORTFOLIO IS A SAMPLE FROM OR REPRESENTATIVE OF A LARGER DECLARED TASK POPULATION
ACCEPTANCE CLAIMS NONINFERIORITY ON THAT POPULATION RATHER THAN ONLY THE MANIFEST
consequence: FINITE 100_PERCENT MANIFEST SUCCESS DOES NOT BY ITSELF PROVE POPULATION_SUCCESS_EQUALS_1
A PREDECLARED STATISTICAL REDUCER OR STRONGER STRUCTURAL/EXHAUSTIVE PROOF IS REQUIRED
OPUS CAN BE DELETED ONLY IF A TARGET_FREE POPULATION CEILING OR OTHER STRONGER CERTIFICATE CLOSES THE CLAIM

theorem.statement: THE FINITE EXACT_SCOPE CEILING ROUTE AND THE POPULATION_INFERENCE ROUTE ARE BOTH SOUND UNDER THEIR RESPECTIVE PREMISES, BUT THEY ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. TERMINAL SCHEDULING MUST FIRST BIND WHICH ACCEPTANCE SEMANTICS THE FROZEN MATCHED PROTOCOL ACTUALLY DECLARES.
theorem.no_free_substitution: A REPRESENTATIVE FINITE PORTFOLIO CANNOT BE TREATED AS EXHAUSTIVE WITHOUT AN EXPLICIT SCOPE_BINDING, AND AN EXACTLY DECLARED FINITE ACCEPTANCE UNIVERSE MUST NOT BE NEEDLESSLY UPGRADED INTO AN UNDECLARED POPULATION CLAIM.

scheduler_effect: IF FINITE_DECLARED_SCOPE: PRIORITIZE COMPLETE_MANIFEST_PLUS_BRAIN_TOP_SUPPORT AND DELETE OPUS QUERY ON 100_PERCENT SUCCESS
IF POPULATION_INFERENCE: FREEZE STATISTICAL REDUCER OR SEARCH FOR STRONGER STRUCTURAL CEILING BEFORE OPUS QUERY
DO_NOT LET THE WORD REPRESENTATIVE SILENTLY CREATE OR DELETE A POPULATION CLAIM

NO CLAIM THE CURRENT PROTOCOL IS POPULATION_INFERENCE
NO TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OR OWNERSHIP CREDIT
